registration_timing.note: This registers the bounded metadata gate after initial public-code review; it is not presented as a blinded empirical pre-registration. Commit is handled by the root agent before any possible separately admitted scientific step.

question: Can the current local WiSig non-equalized and equalized 256-sample Id signals be verified as views of the same detected packet, with supported TX-discriminative safety and cross-RX relevance?
allowed_now: Official UCLA WiSig pages and the explicitly listed pinned public processing/subset source text
Existing local D4 report, preparation source text and saved provenance/schema metadata
Public aggregate raw/EQ signal-count JSON supplied by the separately registered Full-WiSig metadata work package; no waveform or performance endpoints
Filename/directory inventories and ZIP central-directory listings without member extraction
SHA256 of the allowlisted source/report/metadata text files only

scientific_scope_if_a_later_step_is_expl.note: This names the maximum legal source scope, not permission to open payloads or pair by row index. No scientific payload reader is included or authorized by this metadata registration.

forbidden_now: IQ arrays, full compact pickle unpickling, NumPy payloads, MATLAB signal arrays and scientific model/prediction files
Downloads of compact, Full, or Raw WiSig scientific datasets
Scientific forward passes, classifier/probe fitting, optimizer steps or any new loss
Historical held6, target8, dates 3-4 or other datasets for method selection
Calling existing scientific loaders or IndexUnpickler even just for convenience

ordered_gates.pass: Identify official Raw/EQ Id-signal meaning and pinned production steps; distinguish them from the full unsegmented Raw WiSig captures.

Every proposed pair has a one-to-one verifiable provenance chain: immutable detected-packet ID / capture-plus-start-offset, or an authenticated retained-original-index map through all screening, equalization failures, crop/resampling and compact truncation stages. Exact local artifact provenance must connect to that map; labels, shape, equal length and equal array index alone never pass.
ordered_gates.consequence: Do not open IQ, evaluate information preservation, compute view/error correlations, fit any classifier, or implement a dual-view objective.

ordered_gates.pass: Only after G1 and an exact separately committed and admitted source-only payload/evaluator plan: show TX-discriminative information is retained with predeclared classwise and RX-wise limits. The processing source alone, reconstruction quality, class labels or raw-trained-model EQ accuracy alone cannot establish information safety.

Only after G1/G2 and separately committed and admitted source-only analysis: show predeclared across-RX relation between paired view differences and TX discrimination failures. A view difference is not itself evidence of a receiver-only intervention or relevant augmentation.

global_go_rule: All G0-G3 pass with actual auditable evidence. Metadata-qualified source provenance alone is not scientific GO and cannot authorize new training.
exit: Close M0 at the first unmet prerequisite. Preserve all historical STOP decisions. At most one later trainable candidate may be selected jointly with C, and only under a separate pre-registration; this metadata work package cannot launch it.
